03 / A clear basis for trade

Two delivery terms.
One product price.

The product subtotal is identical under EXW and FOB for the same container and unit price. Only the fixed local logistics charge changes.

EXW · Collection in Korea

  • Products made available for collection at the agreed premises
  • No seller-arranged transport charge added
  • Buyer arranges vehicle loading, transport and export clearance
  • Exact collection point confirmed before order acceptance

FOB · Incheon Port

  • EXW product subtotal plus a fixed local logistics charge
  • Transport to Incheon, export clearance and loading on board included
  • 20FT: USD 814.81 · 40FT: USD 962.96 per container
  • Buyer arranges ocean freight and destination import costs
